_comment: THE FILES LISTED HERE ARE KOTVA'S, NOT PIER'S. DO NOT EDIT THEM IN THIS REPO.
They are the substrate protocol modules of the `kotva-client` package, carved out
of this SDK because chunkProof.js was a second implementation of a kotva spec
section (substrate/FEEDS.md 5.3) living in a product. Their source of truth is
kotva/bindings/js/src at the tag below; scripts/check-kotva-parity.mjs fails the
test run if a byte here drifts from it.
A fix belongs UPSTREAM: change it in kotva, cut a new bindings/js tag, then run
`npm run kotva:pin -- ../../kotva` to re-sync and re-pin. Editing the copy here
is the exact drift this pin exists to prevent.
This is an INTERIM mechanism, not the intended end state. The end state is an
ordinary version-pinned dependency on `kotva-client`. It is not one today for a
concrete, verified reason: npm has no subdirectory support for git dependencies
(npm 11.6.2 clones the repo and reads package.json at the CLONE ROOT, which for
kotva does not exist), so the Cargo tag-pin convention this repo uses for
kotva-core -- { git = "...kotva", tag = "core-v0.2.0" } -- has no npm equivalent.
See README.md 'Consuming kotva-client' for the one-line switch and what unblocks it.
A path dependency on a sibling ../kotva checkout was deliberately NOT used: this
repo already records what that costs, in crates/pier-cli/Cargo.toml, where the
kotva-depot path dep makes `cargo build` at the root require the sibling. The
hashes below make this gate self-contained instead -- it needs no kotva checkout
and no network, so it runs in CI exactly as it runs offline.
